title: Statement syntax
description: Curated EBNF per engine for one statement, plus examples that are checked against both the grammar (offline, per version) and real servers. Not a full parser grammar.

wrap.description: For languages embedded in a string (e.g. the MATCH() argument): statement template that runs an example on the server; {{literal}} is the example quoted as a string literal of the engine.

lexical.description: Lexical spec used to tokenize the examples, when it is not the engine's SQL one (embedded languages, e.g. fulltext-query).

word_pattern.description: Regex for a bare word when tokenizing examples (default: SQL identifiers). Embedded languages use their own (e.g. Unicode words).

not_applicable.description: Engines that do not have the statement at all, with the reason.

setup.description: Statements run before every example (per engine).

expect.description: valid: grammar accepts, server executes. invalid: both reject. semantic-error: grammar accepts, server rejects (e.g. unknown function).

engines.description: Engine -> version range ({} = all versions) the expectation holds for.
